They used to be a commander just like you.|audio = FailedGatewayWave6.ogg|[[Titus (Narrator)|Titus]] on Wave 6 ([[Failed Gateway]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Mind Shackled''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Failed Gateway]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had high health but was slightly slow. When it first appeared, it was a [[Boss]] enemy, granting it multiple immunities. It also occasionally appeared as a [[Bloated]], [[Nimble]] and [[Aggro]] enemy. ==Appearance== The '''Mind Shackled''' was a wooden construct with a brown body. It had a dark brown shirt and pants that were torn, as well as two brown bandoliers. It had multiple pieces of scrap metal around its arms, connected with dark brown straps. It had a large grey and brown backpack on its back. It also had a metal head piece with wires and a lens on its head. ==Strategy== *The '''Mind Shackled''' is very slow, but has high health for its early debut. Heavy damage options are needed to take down the '''Mind Shackled''' before it gets too far. Such towers include the [[Crook Boss]], [[Militant]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Golden Soldier]]. *The '''Mind Shackled''' sometimes has the [[Aggro]] attribute, including its first appearance, making it especially dangerous. The enemies accompanying the '''Mind Shackled''' are faster than it and will take advantage of the '''Mind Shackled's''' [[Aggro]] to slip by. **Towers that can hit multiple enemies at once can be used to prevent too many enemies from getting past. **Placing towers in the back may be necessary if too many enemies get past your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Video}} The Hexscape Trailer (HALLOWEEN) - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Mind Shackled''' on a promotional video. }} ==Update History== *'''23 October 2024''' - [[v1.37.0]] **'''Mind Shackled''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping does not decrease '''Mind Shackled's''' defense. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **'''Mind Shackled''' can no longer have its defense dropped while a [[Boss]] enemy. **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping towers now can drop its defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Mind Shackled''' removed. ==Note== {{FailedGateway|[[Neuro Runner]]|Wave 5|Mind Shackled|Wave 6|[[Synaptic]]|Wave 10}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
